name: element.setStatus
title: Set status
summary: Set or remove the status of elements on explicit request of the caller. Besides element.supersede the only command that changes a status; no command changes one on its own (D-030, SR-087).
details: Only a status of each element's type is taken (`statuses` of the type in metamodel.get, ThomasBirkmaier/ReqSeq-archive#306); an element of a type without status gets none. `status: null` removes the status line where the type's status is optional (ThomasBirkmaier/ReqSeq-archive#343).
whileReadOnlyReason: Sets a status from the statuses of the metamodel, and no change can be checked against a missing or faulty metamodel.

refs.description: The elements whose status is set or removed, each by UUID, short ID or identifier.

status.description: Key or display name of a status of the metamodel, in any case; the key is written. It must be a status of the element's type (ThomasBirkmaier/ReqSeq-archive#306). null removes the status line, only from an element whose type has an optional status: no status, or only statuses marked invalid (ThomasBirkmaier/ReqSeq-archive#343); else input.invalid with reason status-required.

items.description: Written file, relative to the workspace root.
